name: Anthonly Handley
quote: Jesse is an accomplished professional. As a designer and UX practitioner, he has a knack for finding that sweet spot between the needs of end-users and the goals of business stakeholders. While at Magenic, Jesse played a key role in the success of several high-profile projects. He is a very talented designer, a hard worker, and all around good guy. I would jump at the chance to work with him again.

name: Mathew Doty
quote: Jesse was a tremendous asset to the UX team at RBA. His easy-going approach coupled with his broad user-centered skill-set enabled Jesse to contribute to some of out most critical client engagements. In the time that we worked together, I came to rely on Jesse's input in a variety of decisions that affected the UX team and how we do our work. I'd work with Mr Westlund again if given the opportunity.

name: Steve Burdette
quote: Our team is diverse and geographically dispersed, but I had the privilege of working in the same office as Jesse, allowing frequent personal interactions. Jesse is an exceptional graphic designer with a mastery of simple-to-complex design patterns and the ability to perform excellent heuristic analyses. He rapidly iterates designs for desktop, mobile, and web applications with ease, demonstrating this on both large and small projects. Most impressive is Jesse’s connection with users; his thoughtful designs anticipate problems and ensure usability. He is unafraid to seek help when needed, making him an invaluable asset to any organization. I strongly recommend him.

name: Justin Wendlandt
quote: Jesse is a rock star User Experience Engineer with deep expertise in both User-Centered Design (UCD, GDD) and Usability. His knowledge in these areas is impressive. We collaborated on an application dashboard project that provided seamless access to application shortcuts. Jesse designed an intuitive, user-friendly interface and produced all necessary artifacts, showcasing his end-to-end User Experience capabilities. Jesse excels at adding the "wow" factor to projects. I’ve never heard customers express amazement as often as they did with his designs. Truly an exceptional and experienced designer, I would gladly work with Jesse again given the opportunity.

name: Joy Renee
quote: Jesse's natural leadership talents helped the entire UX team at RBA. I was continually impressed by his user experience strategy work. He always exceeded client expectations and was willing to help mentor other coworkers.

name: Don Kvam
quote: Jesse is a great UX professional with wonderful sense of design that is only matched by his dedication to his clients success.

name: Elisa Poquette
quote: Jesse has a great deal of confidence and is able to build a strong rapport with our clients. His ability to speak to both technical and design aspects of any project has been a great asset to our team.

name: Jeff Ferguson
quote: Jesse was always gracious with his time, both in answering questions and taking the time to understand what we needed to ensure that the resulting application was built correctly. Jesse's design skills ensured that we came away with a good product that not only worked, but looked great and interacted well from a user experience point of view. Jesse was always cheerful, taking additional requirements in stride without becoming frustrated. I would be happy to work with Jesse again.

name: Monica Murphy
quote: Jesse helped our company with 3D web animation to show our services to our clients and prospects. Jesse was creative, easy to work with and a true professional. We'd hire him again in a minute!

name: Timothy Kemen
quote: Jesse has great patience when dealing with complex issues, a key attribute required for success when troubleshooting complex technical problems. Some much of what we face in life in not recorded in an instruction manual some where and has to be dealt with by patience and persistence. Jesse works the problem until a resolution or alternative can be found. This is an important trait to have when dealing with computer software. Jesse has this trait.

name: Marilynn King
quote: Jesse is a very detail oriented person. He is very professional, and knowledgeable at what he does. He is a pleasure to work with. Jesse is a team player. He shares his skills and knowledge (which is extensive) with all who asks. He completes his task with accuracy and quality work. He is a valued team member of our training department.

name: Mandy Nowacki
quote: Jesse is an absolutely amazing designer. "Going above and beyond" does not even begin to describe his dedication to meeting a deadline, and he produces only the highest quality output. Jesse has endless patience, and the uncanny ability to take the most obscure idea and turn it into a digitized masterpiece. He is very strong in nearly every design suite of products on the market, and what he doesn't know, he masters in hours. I highly recommend Jesse for a senior position in his field.
